hero.title: Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering Mauritius
hero.subtitle: A Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students is suitable for students who are interested in designing machines, developing industrial systems, working with vehicles and understanding the working of mechanical equipment. For the 2026–2027 academic year, the University of Mauritius offers a four-year full-time undergraduate program, Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) in Mechanical Engineering. Students planning to Study Mechanical Engineering in Mauritius can explore this undergraduate pathway and its related study options.
